title: ChatResponse

session_id.description: Session identifier corresponding to the request or freshly created.

content.description: Grounded assistant answer addressing the user's inquiry.

incident_id.description: Identifier of the incident containing the cited evidence.

item_id.description: Identifier of the specific evidence item (e.g. I1, E1).

item_type.description: Taxonomic type of the cited item.

timestamp_seconds.description: Timestamp in seconds where the item appears in the incident video for jump-to-clip.

crop_image_url.description: URL or Cloudflare R2 presigned URL referencing the evidence crop screenshot.

citations.description: Evidence item citations grounding the assistant response.

insufficient_evidence.description: True when the report version cannot answer the question (or contradicts its premise); citations are then empty.

version_id.description: The report version the answer is grounded in (null in library scope).

official.description: Whether that version is official (null in library scope).

draft.description: Whether the answer is grounded in an unsaved draft of it.

dropped_citations.description: Item ids the model cited that the report does not hold (never shown).

usage.description: The chat model's reported usage and elapsed_ms, as returned.

scope.description: incident: one report version; library: a planned search over every incident's report.

plan.description: Library scope: the planner's checked filters and search phrase.

matching.description: Library scope: reports matching the plan's filters, counted by code.

candidates.description: Library scope: the incidents shown to the model.

description: The grounded chat answer (INCIDENT_CHAT_MODE=grounded): the chat-contract-v1 answer plus insufficient_evidence and the grounding record. A template-mode answer stays chat-contract-v1.
